description: review-drawing.ts's system prompt forbids the model from ever producing a missing_document finding -- there is no deterministic missing-document check for drawings yet (unlike audit's compliance_rules-based check), so there is nothing to compute one FROM. Even a structurally well-formed one is rejected.

rawFinding.issue: The model attempted to report a missing document itself.
rawFinding.action_required: N/A -- this finding should be rejected before it reaches a human.
